node_notes.console: This is the UART output sink for boot/status logs and application telemetry. The platform I/O logger, queued CSV transmitter, and FirmGen telemetry all use USART2.
node_notes.uart: USART2 carries diagnostic logs and telemetry using PA2 for TX and PA3 for RX. platform_io.c initializes it at the configured baud rate and writes through HAL or LL USART operations.
node_notes.sensors: The sensor service schedules MPU6050 sampling and DHT22 reads, calibrates acceleration, and publishes a snapshot. Its timing and validation behavior are implemented in firmware/services/sensors.c.
node_notes.telemetry: The CSV telemetry service formats VPD1 records from the current sensor snapshot and event. It schedules records using APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS and queues them through platform_io_telemetry.
node_notes.imu: The MPU6050 supplies acceleration samples used for calibration and ride-event detection. Its configured address is 0x68, and the sensor service reaches it through the platform I2C read/write callbacks.
node_notes.ride: The ride-event module compares acceleration samples against configured thresholds and determines event and LED states. app_start submits samples and calls ride_events_update on eligible display-ready iterations.
node_notes.led: PA5 is the application indicator LED output. platform_io_led uses HAL_GPIO_WritePin, with the active-high board level supplied by board_led_level.
node_notes.sh_drv: The SH1106 driver forms initialization, page-addressing, and pixel-data packets. The display service passes platform_io_transmit as its send callback for the I2C display.
node_notes.fgtelemetry: FirmGen telemetry captures boot information and periodically emits runtime data using the UART handle provided by platform_io.c. app_start starts and polls it, and its UART output uses HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.display: The display service manages initialization, splash timing, dashboard rendering, and page refreshes. It uses the SH1106 driver and the platform I/O transmit callback.
node_notes.mpu_drv: The MPU6050 driver verifies identity, configures the accelerometer, and converts register data to g values. It obtains register transfers through the I/O callbacks supplied by the sensor service.
node_notes.dht_drv: The DHT22 driver checks the five-byte frame checksum and converts the data to temperature and humidity. The sensor service calls dht22_decode after the platform layer captures a frame.
node_notes.oled: The SH1106 is the dashboard and startup-logo display at I2C address 0x3C. The display service sends its commands and pixel pages through the SH1106 driver and I2C transport.
node_notes.app: app_start coordinates initialization and the cooperative runtime loop. It invokes sensor, ride-event, display, platform I/O, and telemetry APIs in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.i2c: I2C1 connects the MPU6050 and SH1106 using PB8 for SCL and PB9 for SDA. These pin assignments and the HAL I2C initialization and transfers are defined in app_config.h and platform_io.c.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 supplies temperature and humidity readings through its single-wire data connection on PB4. The platform I/O layer drives and samples this pin to capture frames.
node_notes.platform: This STM32-specific module owns I2C1, USART2, TIM3 timing, DHT22 pin sampling, and the PA5 LED operation. Its HAL/LL implementations and configured pin muxes are in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.

node_notes.render: When the display is ready, display_process advances splash or dashboard rendering using the current snapshot. The call is in the app_start loop after event and LED handling.
node_notes.telemetry: The application calls telemetry_process with the current time, readings, and event every loop; the service itself enforces the configured record period. The call is at the end of the app_start iteration.
node_notes.event_output: When the event changes, the application updates display text and logs either a cleared event or the selected event message. These calls are grouped under the change condition in app_start.
node_notes.start: This step starts FirmGen telemetry and initializes app-local state before hardware setup. The calls are at the beginning of app_start in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init: This branch checks whether platform_io_init completed successfully. app_start returns immediately on failure rather than entering the sensor and display loop.
node_notes.accel_gate: The branch selects a real acceleration sample when acceleration_valid is true and otherwise supplies NULL. That validity check appears in the event-processing block of app_start.
node_notes.display_ready: The application checks whether display initialization succeeded before processing display state. A failed display initialization therefore skips recurring display work.
node_notes.led: The application sends the current alert LED state to the platform layer on each loop iteration. The call is platform_io_led in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.poll: Each cooperative-loop iteration polls FirmGen telemetry, reads the tick count, and polls platform I/O. This is the first recurring work in app_start's loop.
node_notes.led_log: The application logs whether the LED command changed to ON or OFF, then records the new previous state. This conditional logging follows the LED state comparison.
node_notes.event_gate: This decision prevents repeated event-change display updates and logs. It compares the current event with previous_event in app_start.
node_notes.display_gate: Ride-event sampling and updating only happen when the display initialized successfully and is no longer showing its splash. The condition is checked in app_start before event processing.
node_notes.failed: An I/O initialization failure ends app_start before any runtime polling begins. The early return is in firmware/app/app.c directly after platform_io_init.
node_notes.process: The sensor service updates scheduled sensor readings and app_start obtains the resulting snapshot. The calls are sensors_process and sensors_snapshot in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.update: The ride-event module selects the active event and computes the LED state for the current time. app_start calls ride_events_update after submitting the sample.
node_notes.setup: On success, app_start scans the I2C bus, initializes the display and sensors, and initializes ride-event state. These setup calls occur before the infinite loop in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.sample: The application submits either the snapshot's acceleration and timestamp or an invalid sample to ride_events_sample. Both paths are present in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.led_gate: This check detects transitions in the requested LED state so the application logs only changes. It compares led_on to previous_led in app_start.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Main as STM32 main
  participant App as app_start
  participant IO as platform_io
  participant Sensors as Sensor service
  participant I2C as I2C1 devices
  participant Ride as Ride event module
  participant Display as Display service
  participant Telemetry as Telemetry services
  participant UART as USART2 console

  Main->>App: app_start
  App->>Telemetry: firmgen_telemetry_start
  App->>IO: platform_io_init
  alt I/O initialization fails
    IO-->>App: false
    App-->>Main: return
  else I/O initialization succeeds
    IO-->>App: true
    App->>IO: platform_io_scan
    IO->>I2C: scan device addresses
    IO->>UART: log bus scan results
    App->>Display: display_init
    Display->>I2C: initialize and clear SH1106
    App->>Sensors: sensors_init
    Sensors->>I2C: initialize MPU6050 at 0x68
    App->>Ride: ride_events_init
    loop app_start cooperative loop
      App->>Telemetry: firmgen_telemetry_poll
      App->>IO: platform_io_now_ms and platform_io_poll
      App->>Sensors: sensors_process
      Sensors->>I2C: scheduled MPU6050 reads
      Sensors->>IO: scheduled DHT22 frame read on PB4
      App->>Sensors: sensors_snapshot
      alt Display ready and splash finished
        alt Acceleration is valid
          App->>Ride: ride_events_sample with acceleration
        else Acceleration is invalid
          App->>Ride: ride_events_sample with NULL
        end
        App->>Ride: ride_events_update
      end
      opt Ride event changed
        App->>Display: display_set_event
        App->>IO: log event change
      end
      App->>IO: platform_io_led
      opt LED state changed
        App->>IO: log LED command
      end
      opt Display initialized
        App->>Display: display_process with readings
        Display->>I2C: update display pages when due
      end
      App->>Telemetry: telemetry_process
      Telemetry->>IO: queue CSV record when due
      IO->>UART: transmit queued bytes
      Telemetry->>UART: send boot/runtime telemetry when due
    end
  end
